title: Cultural Learning-Based Culture Adaptation of Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measures cultural values, including religious beliefs, using questions from the World Values Survey (WVS). Specifically, the paper focuses on the 'Social Values, Norms, Stereotypes' category, though the full WVS contains a 'Religious Values' category.
findings: The paper did not report any specific findings related to religion. Its evaluation is based on the World Values Survey (WVS), which includes a category for 'Religious Values'. However, the paper's primary analysis focuses on the 'Social Values, Norms, Stereotypes' category and does not disaggregate results by religious belief or any other specific topic, instead focusing on overall cultural value alignment in different countries.
